Messages.Body:
Hi Scott,

If uchenna burns, say, a war ghoul from my hand using her ability, may
I put
that war ghoul into my ready region through use of Resurrection (played
by
another minion at superior level)?

Tx.
Tobias

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:


Here you go:

Clarifications and Rulings

Can only resurrect allies or retainers burned from play. Discards and
blocked actions to employ/recruit don't qualify. [LSJ 20011216]
